direction: God-Molecule-Show-Studio defines show/bible canon; TRIPPEDD-Production-studios- owns executable production workers and evidence. TRIPPEDD may mirror canon snapshots, never silently rewrite them.
sync_policy: Read both main branches before God Molecule production changes.
Production workers live in TRIPPEDD unless they are UI/show-bible code.
Show-bible changes originate in God-Molecule-Show-Studio and are mirrored into TRIPPEDD canon with source commit recorded.
Executable evidence is authoritative only when the artifact exists and its QC gate passes.
MARS_CANONICAL is immutable and cannot be replaced by donor/generated assets.
